events: aggressive events on the shared lob.observables_v2 tape (prints grouped by source time and aggressor)
responses: absolute mid move 10 s after vs before
recovery of opposite best-level depth to 90% (censored 60 s)

conditioning.participation: development terciles of size / opposite top-5 depth
conditioning.volatility: development median trailing 60 s realized volatility
conditioning.activity: development median trailing 60 s event count

thresholds_source: deribit-eth-perp-2020-04-01 only; frozen in the development run and reused unchanged
simulators: M3 selected model and v0.4 ZI control, exactly as sealed in the m3-selection ledger entry

statistics.family: 3 size buckets x 3 gate horizons x 4 datasets = 36 (Bonferroni)
statistics.historical_interval: chronological 600 s block bootstrap of event means

gate: per horizon ESTABLISHED iff >= 2/3 of evaluable size buckets agree in sign with |log magnitude ratio| <= log 2 AND >= half have Bonferroni-nonzero historical means; buckets with < 100 events are NOT_AVAILABLE
almgren_chriss: empirical proxies only: sigma from 1 s returns, temporary proxy = OLS slope of 0.1 s response on participation, persistent proxy = OLS slope of 60 s response on size, liquidity scale = median top-5 depth
